lr2.postCaptionHint.en: This ad uses the post's own caption. Edit it on Facebook or Instagram.
lr2.postCaptionHint.zh: 这条广告使用帖子自带的文案。请在 Facebook 或 Instagram 上修改。

lr2.runsOn.zh: 每个广告活动将投放在 {platforms}。

lr2.runsOnNone.en: The content decides the platforms. Choose a post or a clip first.
lr2.runsOnNone.zh: 素材决定投放平台。请先选择帖子或切片。

lr2.placementsClipsOnly.en: Placements apply to uploaded clips only. A post always runs where it was published.
lr2.placementsClipsOnly.zh: 版位只作用于上传的切片。帖子始终在其发布的平台投放。

lr2.campidNaming.en: You type the first tag; Studio numbers the rest: {names}.
lr2.campidNaming.zh: 你只需填写第一个标记，其余由 Studio 顺序编号：{names}。

lr2.campidEmpty.en: Optional. Leave it empty and Studio makes a tag for you.
lr2.campidEmpty.zh: 可选。留空则由 Studio 自动生成标记。

lr2.dailyHint.en: Daily pacing is optional: the lifetime total still caps what a campaign can spend.
lr2.dailyHint.zh: 每日节奏是选填项：总预算仍然是广告活动花费的上限。

lr2.issue.contentSpark.en: Meta takes existing posts or finished clips, not Spark codes.
lr2.issue.contentSpark.zh: Meta 使用现有帖子或成片切片，不使用 Spark 授权码。

lr2.issue.contentFacebookRef.en: A Facebook post reference must be pageID_postID.
lr2.issue.contentFacebookRef.zh: Facebook 帖子编号必须是 pageID_postID 的形式。

lr2.issue.contentInstagramRef.en: An Instagram post reference must be a media ID.
lr2.issue.contentInstagramRef.zh: Instagram 帖子编号必须是媒体 ID。

lr2.issue.contentEmpty.en: Every campaign needs at least one post or finished clip.
lr2.issue.contentEmpty.zh: 每个广告活动至少需要一个帖子或成片切片。

lr2.issue.accountPage.en: Assign a Facebook Page to every selected Meta account.
lr2.issue.accountPage.zh: 请为每个已选 Meta 账户分配 Facebook 公共主页。

lr2.issue.accountInstagram.en: Assign an Instagram identity: these campaigns include Instagram ads.
lr2.issue.accountInstagram.zh: 请分配 Instagram 身份：这些广告活动包含 Instagram 广告。

lr2.issue.schedule.en: Set a start time and an end time that follows it.
lr2.issue.schedule.zh: 请设置开始时间，以及晚于开始时间的结束时间。

lr2.issue.bid.en: Set the bid cap, or switch back to lowest cost.
lr2.issue.bid.zh: 请设置出价上限，或改回最低成本。

lr2.issue.campaignMinimum.en: Each campaign needs at least $1 of budget. Raise the total or launch fewer campaigns.
lr2.issue.campaignMinimum.zh: 每个广告活动至少需要 1 美元预算。请提高总预算或减少广告活动数量。

lr2.issue.adSetMinimum.en: Each ad set needs at least $1. Raise the budget, or run one platform at a time.
lr2.issue.adSetMinimum.zh: 每个广告组至少需要 1 美元。请提高预算，或一次只投放一个平台。

lr2.issue.campidShape.en: A campid uses 2 to 40 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, and starts with a letter or digit.
lr2.issue.campidShape.zh: campid 由 2 到 40 个小写字母、数字、连字符或下划线组成，并以字母或数字开头。

lr2.issue.campidDuplicate.en: Each campaign needs its own campid.
lr2.issue.campidDuplicate.zh: 每个广告活动都需要自己的 campid。

lr2.issue.campidTaken.en: The ad account already has a campaign named {campid}. Start from a different campid.
lr2.issue.campidTaken.zh: 该广告账户已有名为 {campid} 的广告活动。请换一个起始 campid。

lr2.issue.destinationUrl.en: Enter a complete destination URL: an http:// or https:// address without a user name or password.
lr2.issue.destinationUrl.zh: 请填写完整的落地页网址：以 http:// 或 https:// 开头，且不含用户名或密码。

lr2.issue.duplicateAccounts.en: Select each advertising account only once.
lr2.issue.duplicateAccounts.zh: 每个广告账户只能选择一次。

lr2.issue.contentCount.en: This plan needs {needed} pieces of content; {provided} are chosen.
lr2.issue.contentCount.zh: 这个方案需要 {needed} 个素材，目前选了 {provided} 个。

lr2.issue.duplicateContent.en: Remove the repeated content, or switch to the same content in every campaign.
lr2.issue.duplicateContent.zh: 请移除重复的素材，或改为每个广告活动使用相同素材。

lr2.issue.campaignCount.en: A launch may contain up to 100 campaigns.
lr2.issue.campaignCount.zh: 一次投放最多包含 100 个广告活动。

lr2.campidLink.en: Ads send people to {url}, so the tag tells you which campaign a visit came from.
lr2.campidLink.zh: 广告会把用户带到 {url}，这个标记用于识别访问来自哪个广告活动。

lr2.budgetMathOne.en: One campaign; about {share} lifetime, divided among its ad group copies.
lr2.budgetMathOne.zh: 1 个广告活动；约 {share} 终身预算，由其广告组副本分配。

lr2.issue.scheduleEnded.en: The end time has already passed, or will within minutes. Move it forward.
lr2.issue.scheduleEnded.zh: 结束时间已过或即将到期，请向后调整。
